title: Simplified Retailers Tax Scheme Fails to Attract Shopkeepers
excerpt: A government registration scheme for retailers has seen poor participation, with only 220 new shopkeepers joining the tax net.
body_html:
A simplified registration scheme introduced by the government for retailers has struggled to gain traction, with only 220 new shopkeepers joining the tax net.

Despite efforts by the Federal authorities to bring retailers into the formal taxation system through the simplified framework, the response from the business community has been minimal.
